title: 特别鸣谢
subtitle: 结语 · 私人学习译稿

source.text: This book, as you see it now, would not exist without the help of so, so many people. Thank you to everyone who helped make this impossible book possible!
source.raw:
This book, as you see it now, would not exist without the help of so, so many

translation.text: 没有许许多多人的帮助，就不会有你现在看到的这本书。感谢每一位把这本“不可能的书”变为可能的人！
